channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: 19 Ways To Celebrate International Women’s Day In Chicago
item.description: You can celebrate Women's History month with performances, gatherings, fundraisers and more.

item.title: Animal Control Boss Defends Record As Volunteers, Alders Sound Alarm Over Euthanasias, Conditions
item.description: In an interview with Block Club, Susan Cappello rejected claims dogs are being euthanized solely for space reasons and said her extended temporary role at Animal Care and Control shaped public perception.

item.title: West Side’s Peace Runners Open Garfield Park Studio, Wellness Center
item.description: Peace Runners 773 started in 2020 and has expanded with more than 1,000 runners traveling throughout the West Side and participating in wellness programs.

item.title: Chicagoans Celebrate City’s 189th Birthday With Bash In McKinley Park
item.description: Neighbors at the "birthday party" said they were excited to get outside and enjoy each other company's after a long winter.

item.title: As Uptown Loses Another SRO, Low-Income Renters Forced To Leave Area: ‘Rent Is Skyrocketing’
item.description: The Chatelaine is the second SRO in Uptown to be sold or close due to building conditions since December. There are fewer and fewer places for their low-income residents to turn for housing — and some may end up on the street.

item.title: ‘The Bear’ Ending After 5 Seasons
item.description: The series' upcoming season, expected to drop in June, will be its final one.

item.title: Block Club Wins Best Newspaper, Best Newsletter In Reader’s ‘Best Of Chicago’ Awards
item.description: It's the sixth year in a row local voters named Block Club's newsletter the best in the city.

item.title: Pet Rescue Groups Defend Animal Control’s Acting Director Ahead Of Confirmation Vote
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson's appointment of acting Animal Control director Susan Cappello to be the agency's permanent leader has garnered criticism from some volunteers and alderpeople. Other groups say she's the best person for the job.

item.title: Pritzker Trolls Kristi Noem After Her Ouster As Homeland Security Boss
item.description: "Don’t let the door hit you on the way out," the Illinois governor wrote in a post on social media after the president's announcement.

item.title: Neighbors Near Obama Center Face Displacement After Years Of Landlord’s Neglect, Union Says
item.description: A once-prominent nonprofit that preserved affordable housing in Woodlawn for years effectively abandoned a Stony Island apartment building it owns, residents said. Tenants say they could now be forced to move out amid an ongoing foreclosure case.
